title: Aye mere laadli zainab
body:

Print
haye..
badne laga jab shaame gariba ka andhera
zainab ne kisi shaks ko aate hue dekha
tum kaun ho jab saaniye zehra ne yeh poocha
chehre se naqab apne uthakar wo pukara ke aaya hai najaf chorke beti tera baba
